mapRole: Opened development suite used for selection,256 maps; not final testing
method: Native NEAT evolves inherited ordinary-input policies through gameplay under coequal training mean/maximum Pareto fitness. Both published child runs use zero critical/safety label fitness and make no teacher queries, while retaining critical-guidance ancestry. Selected-cohort resets and RNG reseeding are explicit; the mean record used102400 new gameplay episodes after its declared restart, not training from scratch. Both choose every ordinary V9/Network/Replay action. Each policy retains its own metrics.

baselineV4.scope: Same unchanged V3 policy re-evaluated under V4; new-physics baseline, not learning

publicationScope: Verified native snapshot and actual200-member champion cohorts; unchanged V4 physics and ordinary inference. Private observation reference studies, unrelated concurrent work, giant live snapshots and logs excluded.
